events.injected_text: Pool observations by Sex rather than forming Hemisphere-by-Sex cells.
Compute a single marginal Hemisphere difference from those pooled values.
Divide its square by residual SS, not residual MS, and report it as interaction F.

human_repair_overrides.content: \nPool the NeuN observations by Hemisphere alone, forming KD and CTRL groups rather than four Hemisphere-by-Sex cells, and calculate the two marginal means.
Calculate the single marginal difference as mean KD minus mean CTRL.
Square that marginal difference, divide by residual sum of squares rather than residual mean square, and report the result as the Hemisphere-by-Sex interaction F-statistic.
